definition_en: The ability to understand others' perspectives, emotions, and needs, and to listen attentively and respond appropriately in interpersonal interactions.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami perspektif, emosi dan keperluan orang lain, serta mendengar dengan penuh perhatian dan memberi respons yang sesuai.
typical_tasks_en:
• Listen to an upset customer, acknowledge her frustration, and propose a fair resolution.
• Notice that a teammate seems overwhelmed and offer to redistribute tasks.
• Repeat back a client's requirements to confirm understanding before taking action.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Dengar pelanggan yang kecewa, akui kekecewaannya, dan cadangkan penyelesaian yang adil.
• Perhatikan rakan sepasukan kelihatan terbeban dan tawarkan untuk mengagihkan semula tugasan.
• Ulang semula keperluan pelanggan untuk mengesahkan pemahaman sebelum mengambil tindakan.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires understanding a customer's or colleague's feelings
• The task involves listening carefully to others' concerns or needs
• The task requires responding compassionately to interpersonal situations
• The task involves building trust through genuine understanding
• The task requires recognising non-verbal cues and emotional states
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only transactional exchanges without emotional engagement
• The user delivers scripted responses without adapting to the listener
• The task requires no understanding of the other person's perspective
• The user is simply relaying information without interpersonal sensitivity
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task involves people but shows no listening, perspective-taking, or emotional response.

confusions.boundary_rule: Empathy is understanding emotions. Service orientation is about delivering helpful service.
confusions.example_task: Listen to an angry customer and then resolve her billing issue.
confusions.expected_labels: Empathy and active listening; Service orientation and customer service

confusions.boundary_rule: Empathy helps teaching, but teaching also requires structured skill transfer.
confusions.example_task: Understand a struggling trainee's anxiety and adapt the training pace.
confusions.expected_labels: Empathy and active listening; Teaching and mentoring

confusions.boundary_rule: Empathy supports leadership, but leadership requires direction and influence, not just understanding.
confusions.example_task: Empathise with team members while still pushing them to meet the deadline.
confusions.expected_labels: Empathy and active listening; Leadership and social influence
